verdict.rationale: OCI's own docs describe budgets as soft spending limits with configurable alerts that warn when you might exceed them, which covers the budgets and alerts parts of the story. The pack has no evidence of anomaly detection on spend or of setup from day one, and the budgets are soft limits only. Missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence that budgets and alerts can be configured from account creation, hard caps or automatic enforcement, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the bill cannot silently explode — budgets, alerts, and documented anomaly detection on spend, configurable from day one

citations.quote: Use budgets to set soft limits on your Oracle Cloud Infrastructure spending. You can set alerts on your budget to let you know when you might exceed your budget
